title: WL-MT404-StrictWorkingSetSchemaAndDenylist
clause: Implement a versioned, quota-bounded WP-local schema whose closed allowlist cannot store canonical product or Locus state.

conditional_execution.approved: Execute this contract normally after MT-403.
conditional_execution.rejected: Do not edit product code or create a schema; record validator-checked NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_MT401_REJECTION.

scope.summary: GOAL: Implement the smallest useful local working-set schema behind WpLocalStore. Every row is project/WP-qualified, disposable or promotable through MT-406, schema-versioned, bounded by size/age/count, and classified by the closed MT-402 allowlist. The adapter rejects unknown tables, columns, record classes and unbounded generic payloads. This store never contains canonical documents, graph nodes, creative-domain entities, Locus lifecycle, EventLedger events, permissions, secrets or authority mirrors.
acceptance_criteria: The schema contains only version metadata, immutable source-snapshot manifests, file/change inventory, validation/build cache, bounded tool-result cache, draft/candidate artifact metadata, promotion intents, local receipts and canonical watermarks; every table and record type maps one-to-one to the MT-402 allowlist.

Every row includes project_id, wp_id, record_class, stable local ID, content hash where payload-bearing, created/updated timestamps, retention class and size accounting; inserts with a mismatched project/WP key fail before write.

There is no column or generic envelope capable of holding Notes/RichDocument bodies, Loom/Knowledge nodes or edges, CKC/Atelier, Tailor, Studio, canonical Locus fields, EventLedger events, permission grants, credentials or encryption keys.

Schema initialization and upgrades are local transactional operations with explicit schema version, forward verification and rollback/quarantine behavior; they cannot modify SurrealDB or contact a network service.
Per-record, per-table and per-WP size/count/age quotas are mandatory and fail with typed diagnostics before disk exhaustion; cache eviction cannot delete drafts or pending promotion intents.
Unknown record classes, unknown columns, malformed hashes, unbounded payloads and attempts to disguise forbidden content in metadata are rejected by schema and application validators.
Fresh initialization, upgrade, downgrade refusal and no-network tests run against the evaluated local adapter, while canonical-equivalence proof always reads SurrealDB independently.
proof_targets: Initialize an empty WP-local database and inspect its complete schema against the allowlist manifest; no unregistered table/column is accepted.
Attempt representative forbidden records from Notes, Loom, Locus, CKC, Tailor and Studio and prove every insert fails without partial rows.
Exercise quota boundaries, retention classes and cache eviction while pending drafts/intents remain intact.
Run migration fault injection before/after each local schema step and verify rollback or quarantine with no SurrealDB mutation or network request.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Schema implementation is backend-only; MT-409 renders bounded health and quota summaries.

target_entries: WP-local working store > Allowed working-set records
WP-local working store > Forbidden canonical data and quotas

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private same-project source records yield no local cache visibility without the source grant.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged project, WP, record-class or source-scope identifiers reveal neither rows nor their existence.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Derived cache records inherit the narrowest source access and are invalidated on canonical revocation or scope change.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Scope-hash mismatch, revocation or context switch rejects and invalidates affected local records.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: The schema contains no remote sync token, endpoint, replica identity or MCP credential field.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Payload hashes, counts, quota errors and eviction logs do not reveal inaccessible resources; secrets and encryption keys are structurally absent.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Local schema operations emit bounded broker lifecycle receipts only; they cannot author canonical EventLedger domain events.
Schema version, quota, denylist and quarantine failures require stable redacted diagnostics.
Long migrations or compaction run through the declared broker job watched by the shared service.

risk_if_missed: A generic payload or missing quota can quietly turn the working store into a shadow product database, leak project data or exhaust disk.

risks: Forbidden canonical content is smuggled through a generic metadata JSON field.
Eviction removes the only copy of an unpromoted draft or intent.
A schema migration silently contacts or writes SurrealDB.
Counts and quota diagnostics leak another project's record existence.
minimum_controls: Closed schema manifest and no unbounded generic payload table.
Structural denylist tests for all canonical domains.
Fault, scope and no-network tests against a real evaluated adapter.

official_sources.title: Turso Rust SDK reference
official_sources.finding: The official Rust API provides local transactions and typed parameters; Handshake uses them only behind the evaluated adapter and a closed schema.

official_sources.title: Turso PRAGMA statements
official_sources.finding: WAL/MVCC and cache configuration are engine concerns; quotas and schema meaning remain Handshake-owned and provider-neutral.

official_sources.title: SurrealDB permissions and row-level security
official_sources.finding: Canonical access remains enforced in SurrealDB; local schema presence cannot substitute for record-user authorization.

research_provenance.selected_approach: A minimal closed schema of disposable or promotable WP-working records with quotas and structural domain exclusions.
rejected_options: Generic key-value or JSON blob table
Local mirrors of canonical domain tables
